command: for f in gz_prelude scanf_prelude dir_prelude; do printf "%-16s %5s lines total, " "$f" "$(wc -l < src/$f.rs)"; grep -c "^function \|^    public function \|^class " src/$f.rs 2>/dev/null | tr '\n' ' '; echo "php decls"; done; echo "--- PDO's build module ---"; ls src/pdo_prelude/ 2>/dev/null | head; wc -l src/pdo_prelude/build*.rs src/pdo_prelude/build/*.rs 2>/dev/null | tail -3
